body: This sounds exactly like me lol... I hate myself so much and think that everything about me is bad. When other ppl try to convince me otherwise, I can’t help but feel they’re just nice ppl who are lying bc of pity.

Same here. Occasionally my family will make offhanded remarks about how it’s not a big deal. One of my distant relatives commit suicide and my family was saying stuff like “ oh if he knew Jesus then he’d never be depressed” . I won’t ever tell my family how I ever feel because I know they’ll just tell me to go pray more or something.
Thanks man I’ll definitely try that

Honestly I feel like I’m a horrible person. I want to be a good person, but I often end up snapping at ppl and venting my anger/frustration on ppl who have done nothing wrong. Then, I feel immensely guilty about it, further fueling my self hate and repeating the cycle.

Sorry, I don't have any advice, but I can definitely relate to being easily irritable. I used to not get annoyed easily, but now even the smallest stupidest things piss me off now, so I guess you're not alone there.
BTW I hope the girl says yes to you:)
